headline.usage: h1, h2, h3, hero text, quote headlines

rules.keep-order: Preserve the primary and fallback order implemented in Base.astro.
rules.no-alternates: Do not substitute other fonts or switch back to the civic font stack on this branch.
rules.small-caps-only: All-caps is reserved for short UI labels, kicker text, and compact button copy.
rules.heading-hierarchy: Use size and weight for emphasis before adding more color.
